description: A custom LinearLayout subclass that displays a stream of card views supporting swipe-to-dismiss gestures, animations, and hierarchy management.

classes.name: CardStreamLinearLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout managing a stream of swipe-dismissable card views, including animations and gesture handling.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a card view to the layout with a dismissible flag.

methods.name: addView
methods.description: Overridden method to initialize and add a child view.

methods.name: setCardStreamAnimator
methods.description: Sets the animator used for card animations.

methods.name: setOnDismissListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be called upon card dismissal.

methods.name: setFirstVisibleCard
methods.description: Sets the first visible card by tag, scrolling to it if layout is completed.

methods.name: isSwiping
methods.description: Determines if a movement exceeds the touch slop threshold indicating a swipe.

methods.name: swipeView
methods.description: Updates the position and rotation of a view based on delta movements for swipe gestures.

methods.name: notifyOnDismissEvent
methods.description: Notifies listener when a card is dismissed.

methods.name: getFirstVisibleCardTag
methods.description: Returns the tag of the first card visible on screen.

methods.name: scrollToCard
methods.description: Scrolls smoothly to the card with the specified tag.
